long_biography.plain_text:
Ali Ismail Ibrahim Al Jarman studied law at Abu Dhabi Police Academy before working in the legal field at Abu Dhabi Police. Postgraduate study in Cairo brought a master’s degree in administrative law and a doctorate centred on criminal law. He later qualified as an arbitrator for institutions in the UAE, Bahrain and London.

At Prestige Advocates, Al Jarman has represented clients across federal and local courts while speaking publicly on criminal procedure, employment, real-estate disputes and access to counsel. He supported Dubai’s pro-bono legal-aid initiative for defendants unable to afford representation, arguing that private firms also carry a responsibility to society.
